method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 23 of 31 breaks heard

lines.english: O Dayspring,
splendour of light eternal,

lines.latin: et sol justítiæ: veni, et illúmina
lines.english: and Sun of justice: come, and enlighten
those who sit in darkness
and in the shadow of death.
My soul doth magnify the Lord.
And my spirit hath rejoiced
in God my Saviour.
Because He hath regarded the humility of His handmaid:

lines.latin: ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
lines.english: for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

lines.latin: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est:
lines.english: Because He that is mighty hath done great things to me:
and holy is His name.

lines.latin: Et misericórdia ejus a progénie in progénies
lines.english: And His mercy is from generation unto generations,
to them that fear Him.
He hath shewed might in His arm:
He hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.
He hath put down the mighty from their seat,
and hath exalted the humble.
He hath filled the hungry with good things:
and the rich He hath sent empty away.
He hath received Israel His servant,
being mindful of His mercy.

lines.latin: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, Abraham et sémini ejus in sǽcula.
lines.english: As He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed for ever.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit.

lines.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper,
lines.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be,
world without end. Amen.
O Dayspring,
splendour of light eternal,

lines.latin: et sol justítiæ: veni, et illúmina
lines.english: and Sun of justice: come, and enlighten
those who sit in darkness
and in the shadow of death.
